value.rationale: Placing one permanent immigrant source on a minimal path can optimize regional occupancy and complete occupancy in opposite ways. The exact unique colonization-rate transition, contrasted with a strict all-c regional ordering, is a useful sharp counterexample/benchmark for source-site objectives; its value is its structural distinction and exact sign law, not a broad field-policy claim.
